options.text: A body. Sticking together is what a body is.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Stuck cells are a body."

options.text: Size and a shared surface, but nothing more. The cells are still each doing everything alone, and none can specialise.
Nothing; sticking together only makes them starve, from the surface rule.

image.alt: A small cluster of stuck-together cells with the outer ones absorbing more light and the inner ones more sheltered, an early division of roles, the gain left as a question.
